hypotheses.description: The Valkey cache instance for api-gateway in namespace rivulet is experiencing high memory pressure due to a low maxmemory limit of 2MB, causing cache evictions of 3241 keys and a degraded hit rate of 45.2%.
An unexpected surge in traffic or a missing Time-To-Live (TTL) on cached objects in the api-gateway service has exhausted the 2MB memory allocation, triggering mass evictions.

tool_args.reason: Valkey cache is experiencing a cache eviction storm and high memory pressure due to low maxmemory limits, requiring a flush to clear evicted and stale keys.

proposed_actions.rationale: The top hypothesis indicates a cache eviction storm and severe memory pressure on the Valkey instance. According to the decision framework, cache eviction storms must be remediated using flush_all (Tier 2). Restarting the deployment is explicitly discouraged for cache eviction issues.
